    • penalizeUnderstaffing

      public static SoftGoal penalizeUnderstaffing()
      Creates a SoftGoal that penalizes each employee missing below a shift's target (down to its minimum) using the default weight. Applied automatically, with the default weight, whenever a shift declares needsAtLeast and this goal is absent.

    • penalizeUnderstaffing

      public static SoftGoal penalizeUnderstaffing(long weightPerMissingEmployee)
      Creates a SoftGoal that penalizes each missing employee on soft-staffed shifts with the given weight.

    • penalizeContractDeviation

      public static SoftGoal penalizeContractDeviation()
      Creates a SoftGoal that penalizes each minute employees work away from their contracted weekly hours, using the default weight. Applied automatically, with the default weight, whenever an employee declares contract hours and this goal is absent.

    • penalizeContractDeviation

      public static SoftGoal penalizeContractDeviation(long weightPerMinute)
      Creates a SoftGoal that penalizes each minute of contract deviation with the given weight.

    • totalLaborCost

      public static SchedulingGoal totalLaborCost()
      Creates the SchedulingGoal that minimizes total scheduled labor cost. In the objective a shift costs costPerHour * minutes, the same unit as every soft-goal weight; EmployeeRoster.laborCost() reports the cost in currency.
